name: Radio Tower & Goldenrod Department Store
summary: Scale the landmark Goldenrod Radio Tower and enter the 'Guess That Fusion Quiz Show'. Score 5,000+ points in the silhouette trivia minigame to claim the Teleporter tool (HM Fly replacement). Visit the Department Store to purchase Johto-exclusive evolution stones, and retrieve the Dubious Disc from Bill's residence.

items.name: Teleporter
items.method: Score 5,000+ points in a single session of 'Guess That Fusion' on Radio Tower 2F (replaces HM Fly for fast-travel)

items.name: Dubious Disc
items.method: Gift inside Bill's house adjacent to the Goldenrod Museum

items.name: TM27 Return
items.method: Surf across the small canal northwest behind the Radio Tower building

items.name: Johto Evolution Stones
items.method: Available for purchase on Dept. Store 4F (Sun Stone, Shiny Stone, Dusk Stone, Dawn Stone for $2,100 each)
